title: San Francisco Transbay Terminal

terrainReference.basis: Current open elevation datum near the historic Mission Street entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: The USDA NAIP frame acquired June 19, 2009 registers the main roof and immediate elevated approaches at First and Fremont. The 2007 California survey confirms the address and streets. The historic engineering inventory identifies an 870-foot terminal slab and a 230-foot pavilion.

note: The engineering inventory and preservation survey describe a low concrete slab, granite entrance pavilion with seven two-storey aluminum windows, sheltered entrance and steel industrial windows in the wings. The December 2008 Qualla exterior confirms the glazing, flat roofline and entry canopy. Deck and parapet heights are estimated.
